integrity: Complete symbolic argument and independent finite C++ type-enumeration tests are included. Prior literature may be incomplete; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two-sorted incidence language (encoded by unary predicates), ordinary quantifier rank four, biplanes with k>=3 only. No claim of extension to counting logic or arbitrary symmetric designs with lambda other than two. No claim of biplane existence in unresolved orders.
title: Three rank-four theories of finite biplanes and a sharp eleven-point representative bound
